lead.title: uniQure: FDA accepts the AMT-130 BLA in Huntington's disease with priority review and a May 1, 2027 decision date
lead.deck: The accelerated-approval filing for the gene therapy ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130), submitted September 2 on three-year data, gets priority review: PDUFA date of May 1, 2027, with an advisory committee tentatively planned. The FDA had reversed its position on this file twice before.

milestone.title: Nasal foralumab: the 50 µg dose meets its primary endpoints in progressive multiple sclerosis, the 100 µg dose does not
milestone.summary: In the Phase 2a INFORM-MS trial (non-active secondary progressive MS), the intranasal anti-CD3 antibody foralumab at 50 µg (19 patients) significantly reduced microglial activation at 12 weeks versus placebo and met both primary endpoints; the 100 µg dose (11 patients) missed on efficacy. Both doses were well tolerated.
milestone.why: An inverted dose-response is a signal to unpack before any Phase 3, but nasal anti-CD3 targets progressive neuroinflammation, an unmet need. The stock fell 17% at the open.

deal.thesis: The Swedish biotech sells mitazalimab (anti-CD40, pancreatic cancer) to Biossil (Toronto, which uses AI to revive discontinued candidates; $153M raised in September) for $750,000 upfront, up to $108M in milestones and mid-single-digit royalties, despite a 42.1% confirmed response rate in a non-randomized Phase 1b/2. It signals a market where European clinical assets, short on cash (Alligator: €3.8M at end of September), change hands cheaply; Biossil is stringing together acquisitions (Theriva).

brefsEurope.title: Fresenius taps WuXi Biologics for up to 37 biosimilars over 10 years
brefsEurope.summary: Exclusive development agreement: Fresenius picks its candidates and pays WuXi Biologics fee-for-service, with exclusive worldwide commercial rights; the portfolio could grow from 29 to 66 biosimilars, with Polivy (polatuzumab vedotin) and Tepezza (teprotumumab) first, and manufacturing targeted at mAbxience (Spain).

brefsEurope.title: ALLOX (CRG spin-off) raises €9.4M seed led by Asabys to map allosteric sites
brefsEurope.summary: Announced October 29, with CDTI (Innvierte) and the Institut Català de Finances. Experimental biology plus AI platform that measures the effect of thousands of mutations on a protein to go after hard-to-drug targets; first allosteric inhibitor ALX-001 is preclinical, and Morten Graugaard is named board chair.

brefsIntl.title: Teva ends its Phase II emrusolmin trial in multiple system atrophy after an interim futility analysis
brefsIntl.summary: The interim analysis found the probability of success too low; Teva drops this trial from its original line-up of innovative drugs.

brefsIntl.title: Ractigen starts Phase II of its saRNA RAG-01 in non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer
brefsIntl.summary: Multicenter trial (11 Chinese centers, led from Fudan) of intravesical RAG-01, alone or with mitomycin C; RAG-01 already holds FDA Fast Track (2024) and a Chinese IND. An saRNA (gene-activating) modality to watch.

brefsIntl.title: Theriva sells its antibiotic-degrading enzyme portfolio (SYN-004) to Biossil: $350,000 upfront
brefsIntl.summary: Up to $91M in milestones ($3M regulatory, $88M sales) and low-single-digit royalties; Theriva refocuses on oncology. Biossil continues the Phase 1b/2a trial at Washington University.

word.definition: A small harmless virus emptied of its genes and reloaded with a therapeutic gene, used as a delivery truck to carry it into the patient's cells.

parts.label: Capsid
parts.role: the truck: its shape decides which tissues are targeted

parts.label: Transgene
parts.role: the cargo: the therapeutic gene (≈4.7 kb max)

parts.label: ITR
parts.role: 145-base ends that allow replication and packaging

how.t: The vector is injected; the serotype dictates tropism (AAV9: brain and heart, AAV8: liver, AAV1: muscle).
The capsid binds receptors, enters the cell, escapes the endosome and reaches the nucleus.
In the nucleus, the single-stranded DNA is converted to double-stranded and transcribed: the cell makes the missing protein.

word.why: The reference platform for in vivo gene therapy, but limited by packaging capacity and neutralizing antibodies (single dose). Hence the race for AI-designed capsids (Dyno–Astellas license, April 2026), dual-vector systems (AAVantgarde's $141M Series B) and regulatory catalysts like uniQure's Huntington's BLA.

startups.name: AAVantgarde Bio
startups.use: Dual-vector AAV platform for large genes; $141M Series B (Nov 2025), Stargardt (AAVB-039) and Usher 1B (AAVB-081) programs

startups.name: SparingVision
startups.use: SPVN06, a subretinal 'gene-agnostic' AAV gene therapy for retinitis pigmentosa; dosing of the Phase 1/2 PRODYGY trial completed (Feb 2026)

startups.name: Dyno Therapeutics
startups.use: AI-driven AAV capsid design; muscle capsid licensed to Astellas (April 2026), CNS capsid licensed to Roche (Jan 2025)
